newsitem.title: BRAZIL: Irish man detained in Brazil for drug smuggling.
newsitem.headline: Irish man detained in Brazil for drug smuggling.

text.p: An Irish man has been detained by Brazilian police after being caught in possession of around nine pounds (four kg) of cocaine at Rio de Janeiro's international airport, local police said on Saturday.
Roger Carr Clark, 50, was carrying the cocaine hidden in a television when he tried to get on Angolan airline TAAG's flight DTA 742 to Luanda and then Johannesburg on Thursday, local newspapers said.
Airport police became suspicious due to the excessive weight of the television set and the strong smell of ether, which is used in refining cocaine.
The flight is also a well-known traffickers' route, nicknamed "the powder flight" by police, newspapers said.

Clark is the 13th passenger this year to have been caught trying to smuggle drugs on the weekly flight. Some 90 percent of the 100 pounds (45 kg) so far seized by airport police in 1997 have been on flight DTA 742, O Globo newspaper said.
A local federal police official would not confirm details about Clark but said the Irish man was in police detention and would remain there until his case was heard in the courts.
